parole.motivo_incerta: Uncertain; Unknown; or from; either; modello unc/uncertain
parole.testo: Uncertain. Traditionally taken to be a contracted pronunciation of either a verb لَيِسَ (layisa), whose ultimate origin is in turn unknown or unexplored, or of لَا (lā, “not”) + an existential أَيْس (ʔays) that has a proposed etymology in Proto-Semitic *ys < *yt. This existential would be a native c
